source_brief: docs/briefs/codex.md section 1 and shared rules; current user brief
original_art_direction_paragraph: grounded stylized realism with a painterly cinematic finish, attractive readable large shapes, credible macro-scale nature, warm brown bark and green leaves. Tree forms should feel feasible with procedural geometry and math/shader-driven surfaces: strong bark ridges and branching silhouettes, restrained microdetail. A recognizable dark reddish-brown worker ant has six legs, elbowed antennae, a segmented body and mandibles, with no human face, clothing or hands. The ant is millimetres long on an ordinary full-sized tree; preserve the enormous size difference. Scent paths, when requested, are a restrained translucent cyan gameplay visualization hugging the traversable surface, never a physical cable or magical beam.
current_look_notes: Current game references take precedence over the initial painterly brown direction. Grey-green shallow procedural bark, olive moss, simple chestnut ant and flat upright leaf fragments; restrained translucent cyan surface trail. See Saved/RefShots/concept-compare/README.md for game fidelity limits.

assets.title: Open climb
assets.description: Tiny leaf carrier on a vast climbing trunk, with a receding cyan worker line and open sky for the title.
assets.composition: Output: one landscape cover, aspect ratio exactly 1.26:1 (630:500), preferably generate at 1260x1000 or higher with this ratio. Camera slightly above and to the side, ant-scale third-person view of a vast curving trunk climbing diagonally from lower left toward upper right. Place the tiny foreground ant around x=63%, y=73%, body no more than 9% of image width, heading down-left so the trail curves away behind it up the trunk to distant laden workers. Bark covers lower two-thirds and one side, its plates many ant lengths wide; a huge simple branch junction recedes high above. The upper-left quarter has quiet desaturated blue-grey open sky and soft distant green canopy only at the edges, giving clear title space. No landscape beyond the one tree needs rendering.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final store-page key art for Leafline, a small 3D ant climbing and harvesting on one enormous procedural tree.
Reference images: 1 character identity and simple Blender geometry/material reference; 2 actual in-game carrying pose, flat leaf geometry and bark treatment; 3 actual grey-green trunk, olive moss, environment simplicity and surface trail; 4 actual tree proportions, branching and sky. Original art-direction paragraph, retained as provenance: grounded stylized realism with a painterly cinematic finish, attractive readable large shapes, credible macro-scale nature, warm brown bark and green leaves. Tree forms should feel feasible with procedural geometry and math/shader-driven surfaces: strong bark ridges and branching silhouettes, restrained microdetail. The ant is millimetres long on an ordinary full-sized tree; preserve the enormous size difference. CURRENT LOOK OVERRIDE: This is updated store art, so the current game screenshots and the user's current direction take precedence over the old brown, painterly finish. Render as an attractive, restrained real-time 3D game still: grey-green / weathered grey-brown elongated Voronoi bark plates, shallow procedural ridges and grooves, low relief and broad flat olive moss patches. No photographic wood scan, deep sculpted cliffs, fluffy moss, lush fern forest or cinematic fantasy detail. Simple polygonal branching, flat leaf blades and a blue-grey sky. Grounded stylized realism through clean readable large shapes and credible scale.
Ant identity: match reference 1: small warm chestnut reddish-brown leafcutter, smooth simple bead-like segmented body, round abdomen, narrow two-node waist, elongated thorax with small spines, broad head, small dark eyes, exactly six jointed slender legs and two elbowed antennae. No face or hands. Millimetre-sized, dwarfed by the tree. Carry exactly one simple green cut leaf fragment, about 1.5–2 ant body lengths, clamped at its lower edge in the mandibles and rising UPRIGHT ABOVE THE HEAD like a sail, never carried horizontally or held in legs. All feet remain on bark. Keep head, abdomen and legs readable beside the leaf.
Scene requirement: one near leafcutter on the immense bark and a single continuous thin restrained translucent cyan scent trail touching the bark, curving away BEHIND its abdomen into the distance. Three or four much smaller workers spaced on that same trail each carry an upright leaf fragment. Trace has bark texture visible through it, no neon bloom, no floating beam, no rope, no constructed road. Workers shrink convincingly with distance.
Lighting/mood: calm, summer daylight with a warm sun edge and cool sky fill; modest dappled light, clear ant silhouette, simple shadows. Soft atmosphere only in the distance. The game is sparse and procedural: do not promise a more detailed or different game.
Constraints: completely text-free image. No letters, title, captions, UI, logos, trademarks, watermarks, border, collage, weapons, clothes, fantasy buildings, mushrooms, extra insects or other game features. No bird in these covers. No fabricated underground nest. No miniature sapling. Reserve genuinely calm negative space for a later title.

assets.title: Sheltered return
assets.description: Closer sheltered bark route in cooler olive light, with a leaf sail silhouette and workers rounding the trunk.
assets.composition: Output: one landscape cover, aspect ratio exactly 1.26:1 (630:500), preferably generate at 1260x1000 or higher with this ratio. Alternative composition: side-on three-quarter view across the gently rounded, sheltered side of the enormous trunk. Foreground ant is in the lower-left third, body about 10% image width, walking left-down on a shallow broad bark ridge, the upright leaf backlit softly, head and six legs clearly visible. Thin cyan trail starts under/behind its abdomen and makes a long elegant S-curve behind it rightwards and upward around the trunk, three or four shrinking workers on it. Grey-green shallow plates and flat olive moss dominate, more muted and cooler than the open-climb cover. Keep the upper third quiet: a broad softly lit low-contrast bark plane transitioning to pale blue-grey sky at upper right. No deep gorge or rocky cliff. Intimate purposeful return, grand tree scale.

assets.title: Branch junction
assets.description: Wider view of a loaded worker at a huge branch collar, with the cyan line bending back to the trunk.
assets.composition: Output: one landscape cover, aspect ratio exactly 1.26:1 (630:500), preferably generate at 1260x1000 or higher with this ratio. Alternative composition: wider view from just above a huge thick branch joining the single enormous vertical main trunk on the right. Branch sweeps from lower right into the center-left distance; its top is a broad traversal surface with shallow grey-green bark plates and olive patches. A tiny leafcutter body about 7% of image width sits near x=58%, y=73%, walking toward lower-right, upright leaf readable against the cool sky. Thin translucent cyan trail curves behind it leftward along the branch and then bends up onto the distant trunk; three small laden workers occupy that SAME connected route. Sparse flat green leaves and distant branch silhouettes frame only the top corners. The upper-left and upper-center sky remain calm for a later title. Tree and branch feel immense; keep branch surfaces simple and game-like.

assets.title: The line
assets.description: Wide bark panorama with a tiny leaf carrier and distant recruits; calm sky on the left for a title.
assets.composition: Output: one very wide panoramic banner at aspect ratio 1920:620, approximately 3.097:1. Compose for the full extreme-wide frame from the beginning; preferably 2400x775 or 1920x620. Keep essential subjects comfortably inside a central 3:1 safe area if exact ratio is unavailable. Low ant-scale camera over vast grey-green shallow bark plates on a single enormous branch that merges into a huge trunk at the right edge. The foreground ant is around x=68%, y=65%, body about 4.5% total frame width, upright leaf fully visible, walking to the right. Thin translucent cyan trail curves away behind it leftward and upward across the broad branch toward the trunk's far collar, with four smaller workers carrying upright cut leaves on it. Bark fills lower half, and some right-side trunk; upper-left 40% is quiet blue-grey sky with only softly suggested sparse green leaves at edges, generous calm title space, not a wall of dense foliage. One coherent scene with simple procedural 3D forms, game-like sparse branching and olive moss. Do not enlarge hero ant to fill the banner. No forest panorama, no scenic mountains, no bird.
